title: Placed machine action
statement: Given a placement of $k$ work tapes into $l$ work tapes, a state map from $S$ to $H$, a state $q\in S$, and an action of a $k$-tape Boolean machine with state set $S$, the placed action is the resulting $l$-tape Boolean action obtained by embedding the source transition at $q$ into the larger tape arrangement and renaming its state by the given map.
caveat: The snippet does not define the embedded transition operation, so its precise tape and output behavior cannot be stated from the supplied formal text.
